params.name: size
params.description: Maximum number of items per page. It must be greater than zero. Default value is 20, maximum is 100.

params.name: startTime
params.description: Start time for audit records (ISO 8601 format), it should be maximum of 31 days before end time.

params.name: endTime
params.description: End time of audit records (ISO 8601 format).

params.name: service
params.description: Name of a service that generated audit records.

params.name: displayName
params.description: Name linked with entity i.e, if an entity is user it's userName, if an entity is RingGroup it is a ring group name.

params.name: auditUserId
params.description: The identifier for user who performed audit action.

params.name: scrollId
params.description: The scrollId parameter returned from your previous call. You can include this parameter in your next or subsequent calls to retrieve the next page of records. To retrieve first page no need to provide scrollId.

items.docs: Retrieve audit records in JSON format
